2014_subclasses.monster-slayer.descripti: Rangers who dedicate themselves to hunting and slaying monsters are known as Monster Slayers. They are skilled in tracking their prey and in using their knowledge of monsters to defeat them.
2014_subclasses.monster-slayer.hunter-s-: At 3rd level, you gain the ability to peer at a creature and magically discern how best to hurt it. As an action, you choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. You immediately learn whether the creature has any damage immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities and what they are. If the creature is hidden from divination magic, you sense that it is present, but you learn nothing about its defenses.
Choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. (action).
2014_subclasses.monster-slayer.slayer-s-: At 3rd level, you can target a creature for death. As a bonus action, you designate one creature you can see within 60 feet of you as your slayer's prey. The first time each turn you hit that target with a weapon attack, you deal an extra 1d6 damage to it. This benefit lasts until you finish a short or long rest. When you finish a rest, you can transfer the benefit to a different creature when you spot the creature within 60 feet of you, provided you aren't incapacitated.
The first time each turn you hit that target with a weapon attack, you deal an extra 1d6 damage to it. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.monster-slayer.supernatu: At 7th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to any saving throw you make that doesn't already include your Wisdom modifier. In addition, you gain a +1 bonus to your AC while you are not wearing heavy armor.
At 7th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to any saving throw you make that doesn't already include your Wisdom modifier.
2014_subclasses.monster-slayer.magic-use: At 11th level, you gain the ability to thwart someone else's spellcasting. When you see a creature casting a spell or using a magical effect within 60 feet of you, you can use your reaction to make a Wisdom check, with a DC of 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the creature's spell fails and has no effect, and any material components used to cast the spell are wasted. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
Can use your reaction to make a Wisdom check, with a DC of 10 + the spell's level. (reaction).
2014_subclasses.monster-slayer.slayer-s-: At 15th level, you gain the ability to counterattack when your prey tries to resist your assault. If the target of your Slayer's Prey forces you to make a saving throw, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack against the creature. You make this attack immediately before making the saving throw. If your attack hits, your saving throw against the target's effect is made with advantage.
Make this attack immediately before making the saving throw. (reaction).
